# External scenery assets — CC0

Downloaded 2026-10-17 JST. All listed source assets are CC0. Served locally; no third-party runtime requests.

- Kenney Car Kit 3.1: https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit — sedan.obj / sedan.mtl. Converted to position and linear vertex-color JSON; wheels retained as separate groups. Runtime scale/orientation adjusted. Original license: kenney-cars-license.txt.
- Kenney Nature Kit: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit — tree_detailed.obj and rock_smallA.obj with MTL colors. Converted to position and linear vertex-color JSON, rendered with shared instanced geometry. Original license: kenney-nature-license.txt.
- Poly Haven Asphalt 02, Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02 — 1K diffuse JPG resized to 512px WebP; asphalt contrast reduced to 60% for style matching.
- Poly Haven Plastered Wall 02, Charlotte Baglioni: https://polyhaven.com/a/plastered_wall_02 — 1K diffuse JPG resized to 512px WebP; used for plaster; paving.webp adds subtle tile joints to this source.
- Poly Haven Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky), Greg Zaal / Jarod Guest: https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky — tonemapped JPG resized to 1024×512 WebP for environment lighting and 2048×1024 for the visible background. This is an LDR background/environment, not full HDR lighting.
- Poly Haven license: https://polyhaven.com/license
- CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Conversion script: dev/scripts/convert-town-assets.py. No generated replacement assets are represented as downloaded models. Existing procedural meshes remain as network-failure fallbacks.
